clues.name: definition__we_call_or_said_to_be
clues.why: explicit naming or definitional verb phrases

clues.name: definition__let_denote_shortcut
clues.why: sentence opened by let/set and containing a denotation verb

clues.name: definition__emph_or_textbf_term
clues.why: highlighted term being introduced, typical of definitions

clues.name: definition__is_a_noun_copula_gloss
clues.why: subject followed by copula and a generic gloss, as in a definition sentence

clues.name: definition__colon_or_defining_equation
clues.why: sentence ending in a display or inline equation that may define a symbol

clues.name: definition__such_that_defining_clause
clues.why: apposition clause giving the meaning of a symbol

clues.name: definition__iff_characterization
clues.regex: \b(if and only if|iff|precisely when|is defined as|is given by|is said to)\b
clues.why: defining biconditional or definition-marking phrase

clues.name: claim__sentence_starts_with_consequence_connective
clues.why: derivation connectives opening a sentence signal a derived fact

clues.name: claim__we_or_one_obtain_verb
clues.why: first-person or impersonal derivation verbs typical of claims

clues.name: claim__shows_or_follows_that
clues.why: result-reporting verbs introducing an asserted fact

clues.name: claim__modal_or_comparative_assertion
clues.why: predicate adjectives asserting a property of a mathematical object

clues.name: claim__equation_with_colon_or_displayed_math_after_claim_ver
clues.why: claim sentences that state a value or formula in displayed math

clues.name: claim__conditional_if_then_assertion
clues.why: conditional derivations whose consequent asserts a fact; partly overlaps negatives so kept general

clues.name: claim__scope_qualifier_then_predicate
clues.why: scope qualifiers that precede an assertion of a mathematical property

clues.name: remark__evaluative_opening
clues.regex: ^\s*(actually|note|note that|note,? however|it should be mentioned|it is (worth|perhaps)|this is perhaps|note however)\b
clues.why: remark-style sentence openers like Actually/Note/It should be mentioned

clues.name: remark__discourse_connective_however
clues.why: contrastive connectives common in side-note commentary

clues.name: remark__evaluative_adjective_phrase
clues.why: evaluative words characterizing a result rather than stating it

clues.name: remark__cross_reference_to_result
clues.why: remarks often point back to a labelled result or figure

clues.name: remark__comparison_to_literature
clues.regex: \b(analogous|similar to|counterpart|generalizes|differs from|different from|in the spirit|the protocol of|version of)\b
clues.why: comments relating the result to prior work

clues.name: remark__explanatory_clause
clues.regex: \b(because|since|as it turns out|the reason|due to the fact|this is because|in other words|that is,)\b
clues.why: explanatory side comments justifying an observation

clues.name: remark__observe_mention_verbs
clues.why: first-person observational verbs introducing commentary

clues.name: proof__argument_connective_opening
clues.regex: ^\s*(\\noindent\s*)?(indeed|because|since|this is because|to see this|note that|it follows|from (this|the))\b
clues.why: proof sentences often open with justification connectives

clues.name: proof__forward_reference_justification
clues.regex: \b(from|by|using|because of|according to|as is clear from|by virtue of)\s*(\\eqref|\\ref|\\Cref|\\cref|\(|Theorem|Lemma|Proposition|Example|Claim|Remark|Corollary|\\cite)
clues.why: justifying a step by citing a prior result or equation

clues.name: proof__implication_between_equations
clues.why: chains of equations linked by implication verbs

clues.name: proof__clear_or_readily_seen
clues.why: argumentative assertions of easy verification

clues.name: proof__approach_or_idea_of_argument
clues.why: sentences describing the strategy of an argument

clues.name: proof__consequence_or_follows_from
clues.why: proof-of-consequence phrasing

clues.name: proof__proof_by_cite_in_brackets
clues.why: proofs that defer to a specific cited lemma or theorem

clues.name: proof__setup_to_prove_with_noindent
clues.why: short LaTeX-prefixed verification remarks

clues.name: theorem__named_result_proved_that
clues.why: attribution verb followed by a result clause

clues.name: theorem__theorem_as_subject_then_states
clues.why: named theorem attributed to an author

clues.name: theorem__classical_fact_statement
clues.why: impersonal statement of an established fact

clues.name: theorem__conjecture_or_theorem_name_then_says
clues.why: named theorem followed by a statement verb

clues.name: theorem__result_due_to_author
clues.why: result attributed via due to/of plus citation

clues.name: theorem__cite_then_bound_obtained
clues.why: citation followed by an achievement verb

clues.name: theorem__sentence_opens_with_author_name
clues.why: sentence opens with a named author and a proof verb

clues.name: theorem__later_stronger_result_in_setting
clues.why: phrasing introducing a major generalised result

clues.name: algorithm__procedural_verb_opening
clues.why: action verbs describing procedure execution

clues.name: algorithm__algorithm_noun_phrase
clues.why: explicit algorithm/procedure vocabulary

clues.name: algorithm__step_enumeration
clues.why: step-wise decomposition of a procedure

clues.name: algorithm__quoted_named_procedure
clues.why: named procedures introduced with quotes or bold headers

clues.name: algorithm__display_update_formula
clues.why: defining equation of a computed quantity inside a method description

clues.name: algorithm__in_protocol_of_citation
clues.why: procedure attributed to a cited source

clues.name: algorithm__inductive_or_iterative_phrasing
clues.why: iterative procedural control structure

clues.name: algorithm__run_or_enumerate_naive
clues.regex: \b(naive(ly)?|simple way|easy to describe|is computed by|we first (seek|construct|compute|sort|initiali[sz]e))\b
clues.why: description of how a procedure operates

clues.name: example__for_example_opener
clues.why: sentence opens with a standard example signpost phrase

clues.name: example__e_g_or_eg_marker
clues.why: inline example markers within the sentence

clues.name: example__illustrated_by_verb
clues.why: verbs and phrases that present a concrete instance

clues.name: example__consider_imperative_example
clues.why: considering a specific case or setup as an example

clues.name: example__concrete_parameter_values
clues.why: instantiating variables with concrete numeric values

clues.name: example__explicit_function_instance
clues.why: a sentence introducing an explicit formula instance

clues.name: example__is_an_example_of
clues.why: copula constructions asserting something is an example of a notion

clues.name: assumption__assume_that_clause
clues.why: explicit verb 'assume' followed by a clause opener

clues.name: assumption__for_simplicity_assume
clues.regex: \b(for simplicity|for technical convenience|for the sake of simplicity|to simplify)\b[^.]{0,60}\bassum
clues.why: simplification framing preceding an assumption

clues.name: assumption__we_assume_throughout
clues.why: standing scope markers attached to assumption verb

clues.name: assumption__is_assumed_passive
clues.why: passive standing-hypothesis phrasings

clues.name: assumption__clause_leading_assume
clues.why: sentence-initial hypothesis imperative

clues.name: assumption__hypothesis_noun_phrase
clues.why: explicit reference to a named assumption set

clues.name: assumption__assume_with_condition_math
clues.why: assumption about a mathematical object with property stated in math

clues.name: problem__ask_question
clues.why: sentences that pose a question to be answered

clues.name: problem__problem_noun_head
clues.why: sentence opens by naming a problem, challenge, or question

clues.name: problem__find_imperative
clues.why: imperative task phrasing, often inside 'Find ... such that'

clues.name: problem__optimization_statement
clues.why: optimization problem stated via min/max or subject-to

clues.name: problem__goal_or_objective
clues.why: sentence states a goal the work sets out to reach

clues.name: problem__problem_defined_as
clues.why: problem defined by a decision or search statement

clues.name: problem__given_instance_then_ask
clues.regex: \b(we are given|given a|given an|suppose we (are required|observe|have))\b.{0,120}
clues.why: setup of an instance that a task then asks to solve

clues.name: open_problem__explicit_open_word
clues.why: explicit open/unsolved wording, excluding topological 'open set' uses

clues.name: open_problem__still_open_phrase
clues.why: 'remains open' / 'is still left open' phrasing

clues.name: open_problem__open_question_noun
clues.regex: \b(open question|open problem|research question|question is|question whether|question of whether|asked whether|asked in|raised the question)\b
clues.why: question/problem nouns that introduce open problems

clues.name: open_problem__unknown_unclear
clues.regex: \b(it is (unclear|not clear|unknown)|we (do not|don't) know|is unknown|unclear (how|whether|to us)|not known whether)\b
clues.why: uncertainty about whether something holds

clues.name: open_problem__desirable_interesting_future
clues.regex: \b(would be (interesting|desirable|worthwhile|nice)|is desirable|interesting (problem|question|to (know|consider|investigate))|future research|worth investigating|one could ask|it would be interesting)\b
clues.why: suggestions of directions to pursue that are unresolved

clues.name: open_problem__unable_to_prove
clues.regex: \b(not able to|unable to|cannot|can not|could not|did not|have not been able|fail to)\b.{0,50}\b(establish|prove|find|show|determine|obtain|propose|characteri[sz]e|exclude)\b
clues.why: admitted failure to establish a result

clues.name: open_problem__question_mark_or_problem_label
clues.why: question-mark endings or explicit question/problem labels and future-work items
